title: Down by the Salley Gardens

nodes.title: Down by the Salley Gardens
nodes.body: Hear the line. The words are a memory of it, after you have heard it. A cut only where it is marked. Singing is offered. Nothing here grades a song.

aka: The Maids of the Mourne Shore
source: Traditional air The Mourne Shore, Francis O’Neill, O’Neill’s Music of Ireland (1903), no. 49. Also The Maids of the Mourne Shore in the Petrie collection. Words: W. B. Yeats, Down by the Salley Gardens (1889). Setting written for this pack, in D.
